linear-estimate.question: Use the tangent line to $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ at $a=4$ to estimate $\sqrt{4.4}$.
linear-estimate.explanation: We have $f(4)=2$ and $f'(x)=\dfrac1{2\sqrt x}$, so $f'(4)=\dfrac14$. Then $L(4.4)=2+\dfrac14(0.4)=2.1$. The exact value is $2.0976\ldots$, so the tangent line is a little too high: the square-root graph bends below its tangent line, and the gap grows as you move away from $a$.
